summary:
# You Are Earth's Actual Eye

Every day, our planet is changing. Forests are disappearing, animals are losing their homes, pollution is spreading, and many environmental problems remain unnoticed.

I started this project because I wanted to understand how we can help protect Earth, even as a student working from home in Bangladesh.

**You Are Earth's Actual Eye** is an environmental awareness and observation platform that aims to help people understand changes happening across our planet through satellite imagery and Earth observation data.

The platform brings attention to environmental concerns such as deforestation, pollution, natural disasters and other visible changes. It aims to make scientific information easier to explore and encourage people to become more aware of what is happening around them.

My goal is simple: help people see the problems affecting our planet, understand why they matter, and feel inspired to take action.

Because protecting Earth should not be limited to scientists or people with advanced technology. Everyone deserves the opportunity to become Earth's eyes.
details:
You Are Earth's Actual Eye

I live in Bangladesh, where environmental changes are not just statistics or pictures in a textbook. We see polluted rivers, disappearing green spaces, plastic waste and animals struggling to survive. Sometimes, I wonder how many environmental problems are happening around the world that we simply cannot see.

That question inspired me to create You Are Earth's Actual Eye.

It is a web-based environmental awareness and observation platform designed to help people explore environmental issues through the perspective of Earth observation and satellite technology.

The idea is to make environmental information easier to understand and more accessible, especially for young people who want to learn about our planet but may not have access to advanced scientific tools.

Through the website, users can explore environmental concerns, learn about different types of environmental changes and understand why observing our planet matters. The platform is designed around the idea that satellite observations can help us see changes that are difficult to notice from the ground.

Benefits and intended impact:

My goal is to encourage environmental awareness, curiosity and responsibility. I want students and ordinary people to understand that protecting Earth does not have to begin with a huge organisation or expensive equipment. It can begin with learning, observing and sharing information.

In the future, I hope this platform can grow into a community where people can contribute observations, learn about environmental problems and become more involved in protecting their surroundings.

Technology and development:

I developed this project as a web prototype using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I used a laptop and a web browser for development and testing. I also used digital research resources and AI assistance during parts of the development process.

Creativity and innovation:

The creative idea behind this project is to connect the perspective of satellites with the responsibility of everyday people. Satellites give us a wider view of Earth, while people on the ground experience environmental changes directly. I wanted to bring these two perspectives together in a platform that feels approachable rather than overly technical.

Challenges and considerations:

As a student developer, I had to consider limited resources, accessibility, simplicity, reliability of environmental information and the difference between real satellite observations and illustrative demonstration data. I also considered how to make the platform understandable to young users without oversimplifying serious environmental problems.

This is an early prototype, but it represents something I genuinely care about: making people look at Earth a little more carefully.

Because we cannot protect what we refuse to notice.

You are Earth's actual eye.
